preserve: All21 prior scoped P1/P2/P3 groups and old evidence; no 3PL calibrations or prior certificate edits.
estimand: Itemwise misfit of the unidimensional locally independent bounded 4PL marginal response distribution under fixed N(0,1), native MAP mirt1.2.0. Rejection is not item-local causal attribution, FWER or DIF certification.
method: Existing frozen joint constrained-Gaussian MAP score/residual reference. Compare raw unchanged S-X2 and separately named standardized Q in development; select one prospectively before fresh confirmation. All native bounds, priors, GH61 estimation and native GH41 S-X2 grouping unchanged.

design.estimation: MAP, default cold max500 tol1e-4 GH61

nonmonotone.definition: Only item1: p=.1+.8 expit(a1*(theta-b1)-.25*(theta-b1)^2). Quadratic logit represents high-trait response reversal. Other item curves unchanged.
nonmonotone.effect: gamma=.25; fixed before pilot, not chosen against observed power.

local_dependence.definition: Generate item2 first; only item1: p=.1+.8 expit(a1*(theta-b1)+1.0*(X2-p2(theta))). Conditional log-odds dependence 1.0; all uniforms independent.

two_stage.definition: Only item1: p=.1+.8*(.6 expit(2*(theta+1))+.4 expit(3*(theta-1))). Two-stage monotone item requiring heterogeneous processes; true probabilities remain in(.1,.9).

pilot.policy: Development only. Select method by null refusal/size and minimum power across alternatives; no scientific acceptance from pilot. If both candidates infeasible stop, do not repeat unchanged. Full fits checkpoint once and shared.

gates.size: Every item one-sided CP upper(alpha=.05/24)<=.07, counting any dataset/item failure as rejection. Retain historical24 model-item multiplicity despite only12 newitems.
gates.precision: Pooled calibration-cluster MCSE<=.004; pooled normal95% lower>=.03; no treating12 items as independent Monte Carlo units.
gates.refusal: Null and each alternative non-evaluable proportions<=.01; failed alternative fits count non-detections. No replacement/retry/newseed.
gates.power: Each predeclared alternative claim separately requires item1 CP lower(alpha=.025/3)>.10; report all3. A passing claim never implies validity/power for another class. No after-the-fact scope substitution.
gates.identity: Raw S-X2/native identity<=1e-8. Standardized Q additionally independently verifies covariance whitening, nullspace deterministic means and active-set KKT<=1e-7.
gates.runtime: Measure actual post-fit median/P95; target P95<1second, numerical validity overrides speed.
gates.completeness: All6000 null and600 per alternative attempted; fixed final acceptance only. No interim acceptance.

precision_plan: R6000 chosen from existing exactbinomial calculation: simultaneous24 size-gate pass probability union lower .996906 if all true item rates .05. Dataset is MC cluster. PowerR600 chosen to distinguish meaningful >.10 detection; exact CP and independent arithmetic audit.
futility: Pilot may prevent confirmation for technical failure or absence of a demonstrably distinguishable alternative; no certification from pilot. During confirmation only technical budget/deadline stops, or final impossibility: observed rejections already exceed maximum allowed even if all remaining nulls pass; for power maximum possible successes cannot meet final gate. No criterion based merely on interim upper bound.
distinguishability: Exact4096-pattern GH121/241 probability vectors. Fit population pseudo-true physical4PL null by likelihood KL minimization with multiple deterministic starts; report feasible-null KL, stationarity and GH sensitivity. Local minimum is an upper bound on closest-null KL, never a proved positive global lower bound. Analytic violated monotonicity/local-independence implications or explicit observable witnesses where available distinguish genuine departure from numerical optimization.
prior_power_bound: Independently verify old coupling via normal-MGF proof and adaptive integration. Preserve .050060264 result only for original historical independent-item generator; do not carry it to new alternatives.
archive: Raw attempts, datahashes,seeds, coefs/pattern counts, source/environment/version, convergence, active bounds, pvalues, native statistics, timing; atomic checkpoints; compact committedrecords+fullartifacts.
confirmation_registration: This protocol precedes every new dataset. Separate method-selection commit precedes confirmation. Failed evidence and protocol immutable.
